svg.text: Sheet 1 — Power bench, 120 W, 48 V → 12 V (scaled from MODEL.md v0.4.4; every value is measured before the first fault run)
CC limit, no heavy switch needed
C1 · C2 · C3 22 mF 16 V low-ESR
★ STAR GROUND — every return meets here
STORAGE BANK 3 × 22 mF ∥ = 66 mF (sweep point 58 mF); measured ESR + ballast = 19 mΩ
LOAD BANK Q_L1..Q_L5 logic-level MOSFETs, gates from bench control
(staircase ramps, two-tier cadence); all on = 10 A; fan-cooled heatsink,
90 °C thermal switch in the gate enable
gate: feeder node TRIP → driver (default ON)
Colours: blue = feeder node measurement, orange = rack node measurement, red = fault branches and breakers. Fault resistors and coils: one value drawn, the others on a terminal block.
Not built: bolted 800 V-side faults (Layer 1; abusive to the supply). The supply must hold constant current at 4.4 A, not shut down. No isolation (common ground); the product needs it.
